text: The Commission on Audit (COA) Nationwide Performance Audit in the Philippines is an initiative aimed at enhancing the effectiveness of public financial management through a results-based integrated audit methodology. This methodology focuses on the outputs and outcomes of public expenditures, integrating financial, compliance, and performance audits. The initiative is part of a larger program funded by the World Bank under the INTOSAI-Donor Cooperation, with the goal of strengthening COA's capacity and effectiveness. The project also includes a Citizen Participatory Audit (CPA) phase, engaging citizens in audit processes to enhance transparency and accountability.
